pages.title: Aquifer Pump
pages.text: Draws water from the rock it stands on - and, in the Planetary Interior, brine and hotter things.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Pumps Water anywhere. In the Planetary Interior it reaches confined aquifers (an Aquifer Sample and Deep Brine), and in its Magma Chambers, Supercritical Water - water above 647 K and 22 MPa, neither liquid nor gas.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Aquifer Sample, Bucket, Deep Brine, Supercritical Water, Water.
